findings.summary: August 2018 Massachusetts certificate records Amazon-addressed Jordan Mergersub, LLC merging into Concepts International LLC, with Concepts surviving
findings.detail: Official Massachusetts filing 201826378650 says Delaware Jordan Mergersub, LLC, formed July 17, 2018 with an office c/o Amazon.com, Inc. at 410 Terry Avenue North in Seattle, merged into Concepts International LLC effective upon filing August 9, 2018. Concepts was the surviving Massachusetts LLC. Arun Rajan and Scott Schaefer were named as survivor managers and corporate/real-property signers; Tarek Ali Hassan signed the certificate for Concepts as duly authorized. The certificate says an executed Agreement and Plan of Merger was kept at Concepts principal office but does not attach it or disclose ultimate parent ownership, consideration, equity percentage, recipient proceeds or use of proceeds. The c/o Amazon address is explicit; ultimate ownership is unresolved.

findings.summary: September 2018 Massachusetts amendment added Tarek Hassan as a manager after the Jordan Mergersub closing
findings.detail: Official Massachusetts filing 201832541000 was executed September 5 and filed September 10, 2018. It expressly adds Tarek Hassan as a manager, yielding manager rows for Tarek Hassan, Arun Rajan and Scott Schaefer. Only Rajan and Schaefer are listed for real-property instruments. The November 2 annual report preserves that split. The record establishes manager authority after the August 9 merger; it does not disclose membership, ownership percentage or proceeds.

findings.summary: Concepts International LLC agreement dated October 2, 2014 names and is signed by Tarek Ali Hassan as sole member
findings.detail: The English agreement in Nanterre RCS deposit 2019/71332 says it was entered into October 2, 2014 by Tarek Ali Hassan as sole member. Section 4 vests management solely in the Member; section 7 permits capital contributions but states no amount; section 9 permits transfer of all or part of the membership interest; section 10 directs ownership-interest distributions to the Member. Tarek signed as Sole Member. This is dated 2014 ownership evidence. The 2019 deposit title does not supply a later amendment or cap table, so it is not used to infer ownership or proceeds in 2018, 2019 or today.

findings.summary: October 2019 France-branch consent was executed by Kedar Deshpande, Scott Schaefer and Tarek Hassan across separate board-manager counterparts
findings.detail: The certified Nanterre packet includes an English board consent establishing a French branch and appointing Joel Dion and Raman Rekhi as branch managers. Kedar Deshpande and Scott Schaefer signed the page-6 counterpart on October 14, 2019; Tarek Hassan signed the separate page-7 counterpart on October 17. The body refers to an Exhibit A covering banking, contracting, financing, management and sub-delegation authority, but Exhibit A is absent from the 16-page packet. The three signatures establish board-manager roles and approval, not membership or equity.

findings.summary: USPTO index records Paloma Tannery, LLC assigning its entire interest in the CNCPTS mark to Concepts International LLC on March 11, 2015
findings.detail: USPTO Assignment Center reel/frame 5475/0588, a three-page record indexed for CNCPTS serial 86458475, identifies Massachusetts Paloma Tannery, LLC as assignor and Massachusetts Concepts International LLC as assignee. The index says ASSIGNS THE ENTIRE INTEREST and gives both execution and recordation as March 11, 2015. It states no consideration. USPTO recordation is ministerial and does not independently adjudicate validity.

findings.summary: USPTO index records Concepts International LLC assigning its entire interest in five marks to Delaware CNCPTS LLC in 2025
findings.detail: USPTO Assignment Center reel/frame 9039/0339 is a nine-page record indexed as ASSIGNS THE ENTIRE INTEREST, executed July 31, 2025 and recorded October 20, 2025. Assignor is Massachusetts Concepts International LLC; assignee is Delaware CNCPTS LLC. Five properties are listed: CC 86524050, CC CONCEPTS 86554656, CNCPTS 86458475, and WILDERNESS WORKSHOP 87616181 and 87616168. The document endpoint failed in the public PDF viewer, so this finding is based on the official index and not the unread pages. The index states no consideration, transaction agreement, member percentages or proceeds; the event is not back-projected onto the 2018 merger.

evidence.source_quote: CERTIFICATE OF MERGER OF JORDAN MERGERSUB, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with an office at c/o Amazon.com, Inc., 410 Terry Avenue North, Seattle, WA 98109 INTO CONCEPTS INTERNATIONAL LLC; THIRD: That the name of the surviving entity of the merger is Concepts International LLC, a Massachusetts limited liability company; FOURTH: That this Certificate of Merger and Cancellation shall be effective upon filing; Name: Tarek Ali Hassan, Duly Authorized.
SIXTH: The amendment to the company’s certificate of organization is as follows: Add Tarek Hassan as a manager.

This Limited Liability Company Agreement of Concepts International LLC (the “Company”) is entered into as of October 2, 2014 by Tarek Ali Hassan as sole member of the Company (the “Member”). ... All distributions in respect of the ownership interests in the Company shall be made to the Member. ... Name: Tarek Ali Hassan; Title: Sole Member.

The undersigned, being all of the members of the Board of Managers (the “Board”) of Concepts International LLC ... hereby consent to the adoption of the following resolutions ... RESOLVED, that a registered branch of the Company shall be established in France ... RESOLVED, the Board wishes to appoint Joel Dion as the French Branch Manager and Raman Rekhi as the Foreign Branch Manager.
Reel/Frame 5475/0588; Conveyance ASSIGNS THE ENTIRE INTEREST; Recorded Mar 11, 2015; PALOMA TANNERY, LLC; Execution date: Mar 11, 2015; Assignee CONCEPTS INTERNATIONAL LLC.

Reel/Frame 9039/0339; Pages 9; Conveyance ASSIGNS THE ENTIRE INTEREST; Recorded Oct 20, 2025; CONCEPTS INTERNATIONAL LLC; Execution date: Jul 31, 2025; Assignee CNCPTS LLC; Viewing 1 - 5 of 5 results.

connections.description: Concepts International LLC survived the August 9, 2018 merger in which Jordan Mergersub, LLC merged into it.
USPTO reel/frame 5475/0588 records Paloma Tannery assigning its entire interest in CNCPTS serial 86458475 to Concepts on March 11, 2015.
USPTO reel/frame 9039/0339 records Concepts assigning its entire interest in five marks to CNCPTS LLC, executed July 31, 2025.
